prompt:
Use case: productivity-visual
Primary request: create one polished 16:9 visual for the slide role "cover".
Communication purpose: 建立主题和核心判断
Single claim: AI 原生知识工作流
Audience: 产品团队、知识工作者与组织管理者
Art direction: premium independent magazine spread with a strong point of view
Composition/framing: asymmetric page rhythm, serif-led headline, cropped documentary image, intentional tension
Color palette: paper ivory, carbon black, oxide red, muted marine blue
Imagery: documentary editorial photography with visible texture and honest light. Page-specific visual brief: 城市、网络与知识流动形成的克制视觉意象
Material classification: image; use the matching visual representation and do not invent factual content.
Continuity anchor: editorial-anchor; continuity group: editorial-deck.
Materials/textures: uncoated paper grain, hairline rules, print-like image treatment
Theme consistency anchors: oxide-red editorial marker; off-center image crop; issue-like micro label
Asset type: background panel or illustration for an HTML presentation slide.
Text: none. Do not render any text, letters, numbers, labels, captions, UI, logo, watermark, or pseudo-typography.
Leave intentional negative space for HTML copy; keep the focal subject away from the copy area and preserve a clear 16:9 crop.
Create a visual asset only. The HTML renderer owns all visible words, facts, labels, and hierarchy.
Avoid: website cards; tech neon; perfect symmetry; generic luxury gold; any text or glyphs; fake data; dense card grid; tiny labels.
